representation:
Two parallel feature sets.
- Model A features: For each SMILES (Drug), generate 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, useChirality=False, useFeatures=False) concatenated with RDKit physicochemical descriptors as implemented in morgan_desc_featurization.py from iteration 7. During training, drop invalid SMILES; during inference/eval, keep invalid rows with zeroed fingerprints/descriptors and neutral prob handling. Descriptors columns ordered per saved descriptor_names_A. Before modeling, fit StandardScaler on training descriptor columns only; transform train/val/test descriptors, leaving Morgan bits untouched; then horizontally concatenate [morgan_bits_2048, scaled_descriptors_A] to form the final feature matrix for Model A.
- Model B features: For each SMILES, generate 4096-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius=3) concatenated with the same style RDKit descriptors as implemented in morgan3_desc_featurization.py from iteration 8. Training: drop invalid SMILES; inference/eval: keep invalid with zeros. Descriptors ordered per descriptor_names_B. Fit separate StandardScaler on training descriptor columns for Model B; transform descriptors for val/test; concatenate [morgan_bits_4096, scaled_descriptors_B] for Model B.
- Alignment: maintain descriptor column order exactly as saved descriptor_names for each model; Morgan bit ordering is the RDKit default for given radius/length. No scaling on fingerprint bits. Separate scalers per model.
- Labels: binary Y as provided. Sample weights: class-balanced (weight_neg = num_pos/num_neg, weight_pos = 1.0) used during Model A training.
- Inference: run both feature pipelines (drop_invalid=False) and ensemble predictions via weighted average using tuned weight w on validation.
